changeSet.author: khrvacic
changeSet.sql: update url set short_url = concat(left(short_url, 254 - length(cast(id as varchar(20)))), '~', cast(id as varchar(20))) where id in ( select id from ( select id, row_number() over (partition by short_url order by active desc, id desc) as served_rank from url ) ranked where served_rank > 1 )

and.sqlCheck: select count(*) from pg_indexes where schemaname = current_schema() and lower(indexname) = 'ux_url_short_url'
select count(*) from information_schema.indexes where lower(index_name) = 'ux_url_short_url'
